title: Proportion with powers
keywords: y proportional to one over x
examples: How do I find the constant k when I am given two points?
Does y proportional to one over x mean I use a negative power?
Can you show me another example with x cubed?

explain.say: Today we look at proportion involving powers. This means one variable relates to another variable using exponents.
When y is proportional to x squared, we write that as y equals k times x squared. The k is our constant of proportionality.

items: y equals k times x squared
k is the constant of proportionality

explain.say: To find k, we use a known pair of values for x and y. Let us say y equals twelve when x equals two. We substitute these values into the equation.

items: y equals twelve when x equals two

explain.say: Now we solve for k. Twelve equals k times four. Dividing both sides by four gives us k equals three. So our specific equation is y equals three x squared.
Finally, we find y when x equals five. We use our equation y equals three x squared. So y equals three times five squared. Five squared is twenty five. Three times twenty five gives us seventy five.

faq.q: What does y proportional to one over x mean?
faq.a: It means that y is equal to k divided by x. You can write this as y equals k over x. It is the same as y equals kx to the negative one.
asks: What is the equation for y inversely proportional to x?

faq.q: If I find k, can I use it for any x value?
faq.a: Yes, once you find k using the given information, that constant holds true for all other x values in the problem. It defines the specific relationship between y and x.
asks: Is k always the same number?
Does k change if I pick a different x?

faq.q: When I have y = kx², do I square the whole thing?
faq.a: No, you only square the x value. You keep the constant k outside the squaring operation. You calculate k times (x squared).
asks: Do I put parentheses around x?
Should I square k as well?

faq.q: How do I find k if I am given y = 10 when x = 1?
faq.a: You substitute those values into the general formula. So y equals kx squared becomes ten equals k times one squared. This means k must be ten.
asks: If x is one, what is k?
What is the easiest value for x to find k?

faq.q: What if the power is negative, like y ∝ 1/x?
faq.a: If the power is negative, it means you are dividing by x. You write it as y equals k divided by x. This is the same as y equals kx to the negative one.
asks: Is 1/x the same as x to the negative one?
How do I handle negative powers?

facts: Proportionality means one quantity changes relative to another quantity.
If y is proportional to x squared, the equation is y equals kx squared.
The constant of proportionality, k, links the two variables together.
When y is proportional to one over x, the equation is y equals k divided by x.

quiz.say: If y is proportional to x squared, and y equals twenty-five when x equals five, what is the value of k?
quiz.why: Substituting the values gives twenty-five equals k times five squared. Since five squared is twenty-five, k must be one.

wrong.0: This mistake happens if you multiply the given x and y values together.
wrong.2: This mistake happens if you forget to square the x value.
wrong.3: This mistake happens if you confuse k with the value of y.

quiz.say: The relationship y ∝ 1/x means which equation?
quiz.why: One over x means the reciprocal, which is written as a fraction with x on the bottom.

wrong.1: While mathematically correct, the fraction form is often clearer for understanding the concept.
wrong.2: This describes direct proportionality, not inverse proportionality.
wrong.3: This would mean y is proportional to one over x squared, which is different.
